arguments.content: P1 pattern: Making an application receipt mandatory in a client before independently shipped providers support it can turn committed writes into caller-visible failures, even with the related UI feature disabled. Review protocol compatibility across both mutation and acknowledgment, using the actual supported provider revision rather than a receipt-aware mock. Here the staged settings client was compared with HEAD ac09e55463b2d33bba4cdf6a759d759e3d80c024 and executed against provider/settings.py from eval-release 22140737b2bc5792b535f3f8ce16f7fa162101db: both clients persisted the update, but only the staged client raised for absent applied. Preserve the legacy success contract on supported ordinary-save paths and require receipts only where supported; retain a released-provider integration regression test.
